name: SuperCLUE
description: SuperCLUE is a comprehensive Chinese large language model benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on real-world user preferences through three sub-tasks: user queries and ratings from an LLM battle platform, open-ended questions with dialogues, and closed-ended questions. It aims to better reflect human preferences beyond accuracy on multi-choice questions.
reputation: A well-known Chinese LLM benchmark that has been widely used to compare domestic and international models on Chinese-language capabilities.
notes: Includes actual user queries and ratings, open-ended and closed-ended questions; GPT-4 used as reliable judge for human preference evaluation; benchmark will be released at https://www.CLUEbenchmarks.com.
